_doc: Baked by tools/bigmap/bake_world.py from data/bigmap/layout_v1.json - do not edit. ground[i]/flip[i]: cell i = y*128+x, atlas tile index and flip (0 none, 1 h, 2 v, 3 h+v); atlas tile n at ((n % cols)*32, (n / cols)*32). walk: base64, 512x512 bits for 8 px cells, bit i = y*512+x is (byte i>>3 >> (i&7)) & 1, 1 = blocked. props: x, y = the sprite's foot point in px (bottom of its opaque bbox), foot = that pixel inside the sprite; box [x,y,w,h] collision or null; floor = draw flat under the y-sorted world (bridges, pads); deck = a bridge's walkable rect. chests: at = the chest sprite's foot point (bottom of its opaque bbox). packs: at = the layout point (design, unchanged); home = the spawn centre: a ring of count members at MonsterPiles.pile_radius fits on open hero-roomy cells round it, it is not on a bridge tile, it is reachable and within 64 px of at. Task 4 uses home as spawn centre, leash and respawn point (wolf.gd snaps to home); members must be placed on open, hero-roomy walk cells, never on raw ring points. arena: the fight area is the disc centre/radius (rect = its bounds only); rock surrounds the disc on every side, so the lock must be a ring barrier round the disc, not a door at the gate; gate = the approach-path cell just outside disc and rect; pack = the layout's boss pack (not in packs). zones: first match wins. Ids are frozen (saves use them): stones w1..w3, chests c4 c11 c12; the game keeps these id sets as constants and must not read them from this file.
